lines.zh: 我每一步都踩碎彩纸，声音像庆典。
lines.en: Every step of mine crushes confetti with a festive crunch.

lines.zh: 我背着整整一年的礼物在走路。
lines.en: I amble along carrying a whole year of gifts.

lines.zh: 钻石在袋里互相碰撞，叮当响。
lines.en: Diamonds clink against each other inside my sack.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，蛋糕不能被晃坏。
lines.en: I walk slowly; the cake must not be shaken.

lines.zh: 彩带拖在身后，一路留下亮痕。
lines.en: Ribbons trail behind me, leaving a bright track.

lines.zh: 我的脚步震得洞穴顶上掉灰。
lines.en: My footfalls shake dust loose from the cave roof.

lines.zh: 我绕过水洼，唱片最怕潮湿。
lines.en: I skirt the puddles, since discs hate damp.

lines.zh: 我朝有烛光的方向慢慢挪动。
lines.en: I shuffle toward wherever candlelight is burning.

lines.zh: 我走过的路都沾着一层糖霜。
lines.en: The path behind me is dusted with sugar.

lines.zh: 我抬脚时，附魔金苹果滚了一下。
lines.en: An enchanted golden apple rolls as I lift my foot.

lines.zh: 我沿着旧年的边界绕了一整圈。
lines.en: I circle the border of the old year.

lines.zh: 每走一步，都像在数一个日子。
lines.en: Each step feels like one more day counted.

lines.zh: 我把礼物一件件数了又数。
lines.en: I count my gifts again, then count them once more.

lines.zh: 蜡烛烧短一截，我就换一根。
lines.en: A candle burns low, so I light another.

lines.zh: 我坐着，让袋口微微张开一点。
lines.en: I sit with the mouth of my sack slightly open.

lines.zh: 我听见袋里的唱片在轻轻转。
lines.en: Inside my bag a disc turns, faintly singing.

lines.zh: 我屏住气，像在等谁吹蜡烛。
lines.en: I hold my breath, waiting for someone to blow out candles.

lines.zh: 苔藓爬上我的脚，我没有动。
lines.en: Moss creeps onto my feet and I do not move.

lines.zh: 我在想，今年该送点什么。
lines.en: I wonder what this year deserves as a present.

lines.zh: 我舔了一口糖霜，马上就后悔。
lines.en: I lick the frosting, then regret it at once.

lines.zh: 风吹过彩带，我以为有人来了。
lines.en: Wind stirs the ribbons and I think someone came.

lines.zh: 我打了个嗝，掉出一颗钻石。
lines.en: I burp, and a diamond drops out.

lines.zh: 我低头看自己的影子，很大。
lines.en: I look down at my shadow; it is enormous.

lines.zh: 我把蛋糕挪到晒不到的地方。
lines.en: I move the cake where the sun cannot reach.

lines.zh: 我呼出来的气都带着甜味。
lines.en: My breath comes out sweet.

lines.zh: 我安静坐着，像一座礼物山。
lines.en: I sit quietly, a small mountain of gifts.

lines.zh: 彩带快掉了，我托了一下。
lines.en: A ribbon was slipping. I nudged it back.

lines.zh: 今天该有几件礼物？我忘了。
lines.en: How many gifts today? I forget.

lines.zh: 你来了，一年里我等的就是你。
lines.en: You came. Of everyone, you are the one I waited for.

lines.zh: 我抬头打量你，手是空的。
lines.en: I look you over; your hands are empty.

lines.zh: 我把袋子往你那边推了一点。
lines.en: I nudge my sack a little toward you.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛盯着我的袋口不放。
lines.en: Your eyes are fixed on the opening of my bag.

lines.zh: 我歪头，帽子上的绒球晃了晃。
lines.en: I tilt my head, the pompom on my hat swinging.

lines.zh: 我认得你，去年你也站在这。
lines.en: I know you; you stood here last year too.

lines.zh: 站这么近，是想挑一件礼物吗。
lines.en: Standing that close, are you picking a gift?

lines.zh: 我眨眼，烛光在眼里跳了一下。
lines.en: I blink, and candlelight jumps in my eyes.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，猜你想要哪一件。
lines.en: I stare at you, guessing which one you want.

lines.zh: 你一伸手，我下意识护住袋口。
lines.en: When you reach out, I cover the sack by instinct.

lines.zh: 你可以看，但不能全拿走。
lines.en: You may look, but you may not take it all.

lines.zh: 我在你脸上找惊喜的表情。
lines.en: I search your face for a surprised expression.

lines.zh: 我低声问，要不要许个愿。
lines.en: I ask softly whether you would like to make a wish.

lines.zh: 你看我的样子，像在看战利品。
lines.en: The way you look at me, I am the prize.

lines.zh: 你打坏了蛋糕，我记住了。
lines.en: You ruined the cake. I will remember.

lines.zh: 疼？我更心疼掉出来的钻石。
lines.en: Pain? I mind the spilled diamonds more.

lines.zh: 我忍一下，礼物还是要发完。
lines.en: I endure it; the gifts still must be given.

lines.zh: 你这一下，让我少了一年。
lines.en: That blow cost me a year.

lines.zh: 袋子被划开，里面叮当乱响。
lines.en: My sack is cut open and everything chimes.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，彩纸落了一地。
lines.en: I shake myself and confetti rains down.

lines.zh: 疼让我想起去年那一刀。
lines.en: The pain reminds me of last year's blade.

lines.zh: 我退后，把袋口抱得更紧。
lines.en: I back off, hugging the sack tighter.

lines.zh: 你打得动我，打不散庆典。
lines.en: You can hit me, but not scatter the party.

lines.zh: 我喘着，烛火跟着我摇。
lines.en: I gasp, and the candle flame wavers with me.

lines.zh: 奶油的香味把我钉在原地。
lines.en: The smell of cream frosting pins my feet down.

lines.zh: 你把蜡烛点上，我就跟来了。
lines.en: Light a candle and I will follow you anywhere.

lines.zh: 我闻到糖味，鼻子先动了。
lines.en: I smell sugar, and my nose moves first.

lines.zh: 别用蛋糕引诱我，我会吃光。
lines.en: Do not lure me with cake; I will eat all of it.

lines.zh: 我盯着你手里的唱片走不动。
lines.en: I stare at the disc in your hand and cannot walk.

lines.zh: 附魔的光一晃，我立刻凑近。
lines.en: One shimmer of enchantment and I lean in close.

lines.zh: 你拿彩纸逗我，我居然上当。
lines.en: You wave confetti at me and I actually fall for it.

lines.zh: 只有庆典的味道让我失去戒心。
lines.en: Only the smell of a party defeats my caution.

lines.zh: 你把礼物举高，我就踮起脚。
lines.en: Lift the gift higher and I rise on my toes.

lines.zh: 我明知是陷阱，还是想许愿。
lines.en: I know it is a trap, and still I want to wish.

lines.zh: 你撞进我的袋子，礼物撒了。
lines.en: You walk into my sack and the gifts spill out.

lines.zh: 我们一撞，彩带缠成一团。
lines.en: We collide, and our ribbons tangle together.

lines.zh: 别挤，蛋糕会被压扁的。
lines.en: Do not squeeze; the cake will be flattened.

lines.zh: 我退半步，袋子就撞到你。
lines.en: I step back half a pace and my bag hits you.

lines.zh: 你把我撞歪，帽子掉在地上。
lines.en: You knock me crooked and my hat falls off.

lines.zh: 一碰，唱片滑出来转了个圈。
lines.en: One bump and a disc slides out, spinning.

lines.zh: 我太占地方，总撞到别人。
lines.en: I take up so much room that I keep bumping people.

lines.zh: 碰撞时我听见袋里叮当响。
lines.en: On impact I hear my bag rattle and chime.

lines.zh: 贴这么近，你是来抢礼物的。
lines.en: Pressing that near, are you after my presents?

lines.zh: 我先稳住身子，再护住袋口。
lines.en: I steady myself and guard the sack first.

lines.zh: 我只和日历成双成对。
lines.en: I pair only with the calendar.

lines.zh: 找伴？我一年只热闹一次。
lines.en: A mate? I am festive just once a year.

lines.zh: 我的另一半是明年的这一天。
lines.en: My other half is this same day, next year.

lines.zh: 两只我站一起，礼物翻倍。
lines.en: Two of me side by side would double the gifts.

lines.zh: 没人给我配对，我是独一份。
lines.en: Nobody pairs me; I am a single edition.

lines.zh: 我对着烛光许过关于同伴的愿。
lines.en: I once wished for company over a candle.

lines.zh: 你把两只我放在一起，很吵。
lines.en: Put two of me together and it gets loud.

lines.zh: 我们并排坐，共享那份甜。
lines.en: Sitting abreast, we share the sweetness.

lines.zh: 爱情不在我的掉落表里。
lines.en: Love is not on my drop table.

lines.zh: 我等着同一天出生的那一只。
lines.en: I wait for the one born on this very day.

lines.zh: 我不捡东西，我只往外掉。
lines.en: I do not pick things up; I drop them.

lines.zh: 地上有颗钻石，我用脚踢开。
lines.en: A diamond lies on the ground, so I kick it.

lines.zh: 我的袋子只出不进。
lines.en: My sack only empties, never fills.

lines.zh: 我不拾取，我是被拾取的那个。
lines.en: I am never the picker, always the picked.

lines.zh: 你丢下的东西，我看都不看。
lines.en: Whatever you drop, I do not even glance at.

lines.zh: 弯腰会压到蛋糕，我不弯。
lines.en: Bending would squash the cake, so I stay upright.

lines.zh: 我把它推给你，你捡起来。
lines.en: I push it toward you; you pick it up.

lines.zh: 我连自己的彩纸都懒得收。
lines.en: I cannot be bothered to gather my own confetti.

lines.zh: 掉落才是我的差事，不是捡。
lines.en: Dropping is my duty, not collecting.

lines.zh: 我绕开糖纸，脚步没有停。
lines.en: I step around the candy wrappers without pausing.

lines.zh: 我盯上你了，因为你在跑。
lines.en: I have my eye on you, because you are running.

lines.zh: 我选了你，你看上去能带走礼物。
lines.en: I choose you; you look able to carry gifts.

lines.zh: 我锁定目标，先数他的口袋。
lines.en: I lock on and count your pockets first.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转向你，袋子已经备好。
lines.en: I turn toward you slowly, sack already ready.

lines.zh: 你跑得越快，我越想追。
lines.en: The faster you run, the more I want to chase.

lines.zh: 我把你写进今年的名单里。
lines.en: I write your name into this year's list.

lines.zh: 我锁的不是猎物，是收件人。
lines.en: What I target is not prey, but a recipient.

lines.zh: 我的视线一直跟着你的后颈。
lines.en: My gaze has been following the back of your neck.

lines.zh: 我选中了那个空着手的。
lines.en: I pick the one whose hands are empty.

lines.zh: 我迈第一步，地面就在震。
lines.en: I take my first step and the ground trembles.

lines.zh: 我把目标定在最近的那个人。
lines.en: I set my aim on whoever stands nearest.

lines.zh: 我的目光把这条路封住了。
lines.en: My gaze closes off this road behind you.

lines.zh: 我一直看着你，眼都不眨。
lines.en: My eyes stay on you and never once close.

lines.zh: 你挪一步，我这边的地就沉一下。
lines.en: Each step you take, the ground on my side sinks.

lines.zh: 我举着袋子，像举着武器。
lines.en: I hold up my sack as if it were a weapon.

lines.zh: 我的脚步声越来越近了。
lines.en: My footsteps come closer and closer.

lines.zh: 我在等你先伸出手来。
lines.en: I am waiting for you to reach out first.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转，找一个空隙。
lines.en: I circle you, hunting for a gap.

lines.zh: 你藏在树后，我也看得见。
lines.en: Hide behind that tree; I still see you.

lines.zh: 我不急，我有一整年时间。
lines.en: I am in no hurry. I have a whole year.

lines.zh: 我低声数着，三、二、一。
lines.en: I count down quietly: three, two, one.

lines.zh: 你越是躲，我越显得巨大。
lines.en: The more you hide, the larger I seem.

lines.zh: 我把影子挪到你脚下面。
lines.en: I slide my shadow under your feet.

lines.zh: 我手里的烛光晃着，像讯号。
lines.en: The candle in my hand flickers like a signal.

lines.zh: 我停在一步外，等你自己过来。
lines.en: I stop one pace away and wait for you.

lines.zh: 我一甩袋子，礼物和疼一起到。
lines.en: I swing my sack, and gifts arrive with pain.

lines.zh: 我抬手拍下，彩纸和土一起飞。
lines.en: I bring my hand down, confetti and dirt flying.

lines.zh: 这不算打，这算发礼物。
lines.en: This is not a blow, it is a delivery.

lines.zh: 我撞你一下，你掉了半格血。
lines.en: One shove from me and you lose half a heart.

lines.zh: 我朝你砸出蛋糕，太浪费了。
lines.en: I hurl a cake at you, which is wasteful.

lines.zh: 我压低身子再顶，像过节公牛。
lines.en: I lower my bulk and butt you like a festival bull.

lines.zh: 我打你时，钻石从袋缝掉出来。
lines.en: Diamonds slip from my sack as I hit you.

lines.zh: 我的力道是庆祝性的。
lines.en: My strength is entirely celebratory.

lines.zh: 你被我一推，退了三步。
lines.en: One push from me and you stagger three steps.

lines.zh: 我甩尾巴扫倒你，再道歉。
lines.en: I sweep you down with my tail, then apologize.

lines.zh: 我从彩纸堆里站了起来。
lines.en: I rise out of a heap of confetti.

lines.zh: 一年只有这一次，我来了。
lines.en: Once a year only, and here I am.

lines.zh: 蜡烛先亮，然后是我的眼睛。
lines.en: The candles light first, then my eyes.

lines.zh: 我出现在这，带着整年的礼物。
lines.en: I appear here with a full year of presents.

lines.zh: 土里冒出丝带，接着是我。
lines.en: Ribbons push out of the soil, then me.

lines.zh: 我从蛋糕的香气里凝聚成形。
lines.en: I take shape out of the smell of cake.

lines.zh: 我落地时压平了一片草。
lines.en: Landing, I flatten a patch of grass.

lines.zh: 唱片开始转，我就有了影子。
lines.en: The disc begins to spin, and I have a shadow.

lines.zh: 这是庆典的时辰，我准时到。
lines.en: This is the hour of the party, and I am punctual.

lines.zh: 我从光里挤出来，袋子先落地。
lines.en: I squeeze out of the light, sack landing first.

lines.zh: 我一睁眼，四周就开始热闹。
lines.en: The moment I open my eyes, things get lively.

lines.zh: 我是被这一整年叫醒的。
lines.en: This year called me awake.

lines.zh: 我踩着倒计时的最后一拍出现。
lines.en: I arrive on the last beat of the countdown.

lines.zh: 我出现的地方，草都长出了花。
lines.en: Where I appear, flowers push through the grass.

lines.zh: 别烧我的彩带，它们很贵。
lines.en: Do not burn my ribbons, they are expensive.

lines.zh: 我摔下来，袋子先响了一声。
lines.en: I land hard and my sack rings first.

lines.zh: 我沉下去，蛋糕在水里化开。
lines.en: I sink, and the cake dissolves in the water.

lines.zh: 这一炸，我掉了三件礼物。
lines.en: That blast knocked three gifts out of me.

lines.zh: 箭扎在袋子上，我数着它。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my sack; I count it.

lines.zh: 魔法让我想起自己是造出来的。
lines.en: Magic reminds me that I was made, not born.

lines.zh: 我饿，但蛋糕不归我吃。
lines.en: I am starving, but the cake is not mine to eat.

lines.zh: 雷打中彩带，火花很好看。
lines.en: Lightning hits my ribbons and the sparks are pretty.

lines.zh: 我往下掉，礼物散进黑里。
lines.en: I fall, and the gifts scatter into the dark.
